cases.watch: 「绝了」「yyds」「卡成 PPT」「摸鱼」「躺平」要有英文註解且意思對；「收到」不能翻成 received

translations.text: The new version's startup speed is unreal — the GOAT.

idioms.meaning: insane; unreal — an exclamation that something is amazingly good (or amazingly bad)
idioms.usage: People say it when something blows them away, good or bad, like a new build that starts instantly.

idioms.meaning: short for 永远的神, "eternal god" — the GOAT, the greatest of all time
idioms.usage: People use it online to hype up something they think is the absolute best, e.g. 这个功能 yyds.

translations.text: For real? Mine still lags so bad it's like a slideshow.

idioms.usage: People say it when what they just heard doesn't match their own experience, e.g. 真的假的，你一次就过了？

idioms.meaning: so laggy it's like a PowerPoint slideshow — stuttering, frame-by-frame slow
idioms.usage: People say it when an app or device is painfully laggy, e.g. 这游戏卡成 PPT 了。

translations.text: Did you forget to clear the cache, haha?
I cleared it and it's still the same. Gonna slack off for now, I'll deal with it tomorrow.

idioms.meaning: to slack off; to goof around on the job instead of working
idioms.usage: People say it when they're killing time at work or school instead of doing what they should, e.g. 上午都在摸鱼。

translations.text: Got it. I'm lying flat too.

idioms.usage: People say it in chats to confirm they've received and understood something, e.g. 收到，马上处理。

idioms.meaning: to lie flat — to give up striving and just coast, especially in reaction to pressure or exhaustion
idioms.usage: People say it when they've decided to stop pushing and just let things be, e.g. 太累了，今晚躺平。

translations.text: The new version's startup speed is unreal — GOAT status

idioms.usage: Said when something is so impressive it's almost unbelievable, often with a hint of amazement.

idioms.meaning: GOAT — 'the eternal god', i.e. the absolute best
idioms.usage: Internet slang used to praise someone or something as the greatest ever.

translations.text: For real? Mine's still laggy as hell

idioms.meaning: so laggy it's like flipping through slides
idioms.usage: Said when an app or device stutters so badly it looks like a slideshow.

translations.text: Did you forget to clear the cache? Haha
I did, still the same. Gonna slack off for now, deal with it tomorrow

idioms.meaning: slack off / goof off at work
idioms.usage: Said when someone kills time or slacks during work hours; originally 'catching fish' in muddy water.

translations.text: Got it — I'm checking out too

idioms.usage: A quick acknowledgment, like 'noted' or 'roger that'.

idioms.meaning: to lie flat / give up and stop trying
